about:
Standard Supply Electronics operates from South Salt Lake, Utah, as an independent distributor of electronic components. The company is a member of the Edge Group, a distributor-owned buying and marketing group headquartered in Houston, Texas, that comprises more than 100 independent distributors and offers access to over 200 product lines from leading manufacturers.

The company stocks thousands of electronic components across categories such as soldering supplies, connectors, transistors, cables, heat-shrink tubing, diodes, batteries, fuses, tools, capacitors, banana plugs, and resistors. Beyond its own webstore, Standard Supply Electronics sells through Amazon and eBay marketplaces, extending its reach to customers who prefer those platforms.

Its customer base spans the datacom, security, low-voltage, electronic MRO, and electronic OEM sectors. The Edge Group membership allows Standard Supply Electronics to source material and leverage collective inventory for buyers in those industries.

The company emphasizes that its group affiliation gives it the purchasing power and inventory depth of a much larger organization, enabling it to supply hard-to-find items and support both maintenance and original-equipment production needs.
